viewerNote: You can see this suite's operations, but only members can run them. Ask an org owner for the member role.

checks.title: Checks and admission
checks.description: Lint checks suite.yaml and every task. Lock pins task hashes and images. Admit runs each task's reference solution and verifier so the task can be used in experiments.
checks.admitConfirm: Admit every task of {{suite}}? This builds images and runs each reference solution in containers.
checks.hostedAdmit: Hosted admission runs the oracle and noop controls of each task on a runner (Runners page) and records the result in suite.lock. Admitted tasks can be run right after.
checks.hostedAdmitConfirm: Admit every task of {{suite}}? Each task runs its oracle and noop controls on a runner, with a scripted model (no model spend).

health.title: Quarantine
health.description: A quarantined task is skipped by new plans. suite.lock and finished experiments are unchanged. Restore puts it back.
health.flakyConfirm: Quarantine every task of {{suite}} with verifier flakiness evidence?
health.empty: This suite has no tasks yet. Cut one from a commit below.
health.reasonRequired: Type a reason first: say why the task is kept out of new plans.

source.githubHint: Private repositories need GitHub connected in Settings. Public ones work without it.
source.localHint: A git repository on the server's disk, absolute or relative to the project folder.

fromCommit.title: Task from a commit
fromCommit.description: Cut a task from a fix: the agent starts at the base commit, and the reference commit gives the solution and the hidden tests.
fromCommit.missing: Fill in task id, base and reference, and pick a repository.

mine.title: Mine tasks from history
mine.description: Rank recent fix commits that change tests and cut proven tasks from the best ones.
mine.hostedDryRun: A full mine cuts the candidates, proves them with the oracle and noop controls on a runner (Runners page), keeps only the proven tasks and records their admission in suite.lock.
